title: HollowKeep
author: Legitimate-SoLoS
selftext:
The Keep is falling, but its fire is still lit.

In HollowKeep, you are a Warden defending a crumbling bastion against the darkness. Fight through night sieges, rebuild the camp between attacks, meet its survivors, and uncover the story of the Sigil and the Vigils. Your journey unfolds in the World Book, while a separate Bestiary records the creatures you encounter.

Survive to Night 5 to unlock Onslaught, an endless survival trial beneath the Sigil. Enemies pursue you in growing waves as you collect loot, equip stronger gear, sell what you do not need, and choose upgrades to keep the fight going.

This is a playable, in-development preview from One Man Studios. Your support helps us polish combat, art, sound, accessibility, and the world of HollowKeep. Play on Windows with keyboard or controller, or try the experimental Android build with touch controls. Android performance and compatibility are still being tested.

Come check it out at [https://ko-fi.com/s/4b07e1193c](https://ko-fi.com/s/4b07e1193c)
